nodes.description: Public uint256 counter tracking the number of wedding messages stored; used as the mapping key index and incremented on each creation.
Private mapping(uint256 => string) storing the wedding message text keyed by message ID.
Private mapping(uint256 => string) storing the author/assistant name keyed by message ID.
Private address set to the deployer in the constructor; authorized caller of the cashback withdrawal.
Constructor that initializes the contract owner with msg.sender.
Payable function that stores a message and its author in the mappings and increments amountOfMessages.
Public view function returning the author and message associated with a given tokenId.
Owner-restricted function that transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, as the access-control check in cashback, and as the withdrawal recipient.
External payable transfer(address(msg.sender)).transfer(address(this).balance) inside cashback, forwarding value to an attacker-influenced address.
Arithmetic update amountOfMessages = amountOfMessages + 1 performed while storing a new message.
String parameter naming the author of the wedding message.
String parameter holding the wedding message content to store.
uint256 parameter identifying which stored message to read.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the constructor to initialize the owner address.
The constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable, establishing the privileged account.
Parameter iAm flows into createWeedingMessage where it is written to _assistant.
Parameter message flows into createWeedingMessage where it is written to _wedMessages.
createWeedingMessage writes the caller-supplied message into the _wedMessages mapping.
createWeedingMessage writes the caller-supplied author string into the _assistant mapping.
createWeedingMessage reads amountOfMessages to use as the mapping key for the new entry.
The current amountOfMessages value is the operand of the increment operation.
The incremented value is written back to amountOfMessages, the counter used as a mapping index.
Parameter tokenId is used as the lookup key inside getWedMessage.
getWedMessage reads the _assistant mapping for the requested tokenId.
getWedMessage reads the _wedMessages mapping for the requested tokenId.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the require statement guarding cashback.
The owner state variable is read by cashback for the privileged caller check.
cashback reaches the external balance transfer unsafe operation after the access-control check.
The external transfer sends value to msg.sender, which may execute a fallback and re-enter contract functions.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter iAm has no independent identity outside createWeedingMessage and is only meaningful as its input argument.
Parameter message is solely an input to createWeedingMessage and should be folded into that core function node.
Parameter tokenId exists only as the lookup argument of getWedMessage and should be merged into that function node.
